title: Never Hand a Plaintext Key
title_zh: 别把明文钥匙交进上下文
summary: Why raw API keys in an agent's context fail in a single turn, and how NyxID keeps secrets inside an encrypted proxy: narrow capability handles, 55 built-in services, 41 OpenAPI-to-MCP specs, 9 messaging channels, a human gate for writes and a revocation that converges in about two seconds.
summary_zh: 为什么塞进 Agent 上下文的明文 API 密钥会在一轮之内失守，以及 NyxID 如何把密钥留在加密代理之内：窄作用域能力句柄、55 项内置服务、41 份 OpenAPI 转 MCP 规范、9 类消息渠道、写操作人工闸门与约两秒生效的吊销。
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: trureturing cyberpunk · a leaking context window, a proxy vault, a human gate and a hot revocation
